'''AthleticGal''' was a company that sold the [[Swimsuit/Legends|bathing tog]] line [[Aquawear]]. At some point, an advertisement was put up by AthleticGal on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] to promote Aquawear, including exclusive [[Hologram/Legends|holos]], model data, and [[Species/Legends|species]] gallery.<ref name="HNN Ad" />

==Behind the scenes==
AthleticGal first appeared in the [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'']],<ref name="HNN Ad" /> an [[in-universe]] website originally published on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> The company was featured through one of the interchangeable advertisements seen on the website.<ref name="HNN Ad" />
